create_rpc_server: subclass rpc.Server to create a torch distributed RPC server with custom methods
create_rpc_client: instantiate rpc.Client to connect to a Server and call remote methods transparently
send_data_to_node: use rpc.send to serialize and send a torch object to a destination node rank
recv_data_from_node: use rpc.recv to receive and deserialize a torch object from a source node rank
join_rpc_clients: call client.join to signal completion and ensure all clients exit cleanly
